displaySwitches.title: Display switches

conversion.title: Convert the data of {{project}}
conversion.waitingHint: This project's data is at version {{from}}, older than this KaTyoti's: convert it to work on it.
conversion.openToConvert: This project's data is at version {{from}}, older than this KaTyoti's: open it, then « Convert » in its panel.
conversion.newerHint: This project's data is at version {{from}}, newer than this KaTyoti knows: update KaTyoti.
conversion.versions: Its data goes from version {{from}} to version {{to}}, through these steps:
conversion.treeClean: Git: every file the conversion writes is as the last commit has it.
conversion.treeNoRepo: This project is in no git repository: nothing will be committed - keep a copy of its folder first.
conversion.treeDirty_one: Git: {{count}} file the conversion writes has uncommitted changes - commit or discard it first:
conversion.treeDirty_other: Git: {{count}} files the conversion writes have uncommitted changes - commit or discard them first:
conversion.noWayBack: There is no way back: once converted, the data no longer opens with an older KaTyoti. The conversion lands as one commit of its own.
conversion.upToDate: The project's data is already at version {{to}}: nothing to convert.
conversion.reached_one: Data now at version {{to}}: {{count}} file rewritten.
conversion.reached_other: Data now at version {{to}}: {{count}} files rewritten.
conversion.endNoRepo: Nothing committed: the project is in no git repository.
conversion.refused: Converted, not committed - git refused the commit; commit the converted files by hand:
